note: The soundtrack mix of the fable on radio cut v1: Tom, the night, the score the artist chose (m3-f-1 at level 3) and the four effects the artist chose (round s1), with the pond's ripples made in code from the pond take. Read by scripts/fable/mix.py; its measurements go to scripts/fable/mix-render.json. Reviewed by the sound designer before rendering (decision 17, 2026-11-08).

curtains.why: from 0.5 s, loudest moment -30 LUFS momentary, over before the first line

branch.why: from 0.5 s before paragraph 19, one gain: 12 LU under each line it lies under, 9 through the phone stand-in

touch.why: peak 0.25 s into the 1 s gap at the touch, -26 LUFS momentary, faded where Tom resumes

in.why: cut in with the picture's cut to the pond, in the silence before paragraph 6 (hard cuts between places; the image leads the words). A placeholder until the exposure sheet gives the frame.

pond.level: One level: under words it only masks Tom's consonants (it is the only sound above 2 kHz); in the silences it stays the only water up there.

splice.why: the ease and the rest are 59.9 s apart, three loops, so without a jump they replay the same lapping; the read jumps 10 s under paragraph 11

ripples.why: A second read of the pond take, brighter and 7 dB over the bed, placed so a lap starts 0.35 s after the touch's peak, inside the silence. From the touch, bed and stir decay together on one envelope (tau 2.5 s in amplitude, about -3.5 dB/s), reach the night's level in the silence after 'breaking her reflection into pieces.', and are digital silence by the end of 'still,' (139.47 s, Scribe).
ripples.underWords: Under 'His paw struck the water...' the ripples keep the branch's rule (12 LU under the line, 9 through the phone stand-in): placed as above they came within 4.2 LU of Tom on the phone, the closest sound to him in the film. The rule only ever lowers them.

score.why: The score is the one the artist chose; it is eased only where the effects and night under a line would bring the bed within the floors below, held 1.5 s before to 2.5 s after the line and smoothed over 2 s, as its own ride.

night.why: As locked in the radio cut. The music review offered the artist the night from -42 again; -45 stands unless the artist asks (through the phone stand-in it is -47.6 to -51.4 short-term in the long silences).
